{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Ask a Twi'lek. It's not flattering.|Atton Rand|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
A '''schutta''' was a weasel-like animal indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref> It was used as an insult specific to [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|females]],<ref name="Glossary">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 1]]'' alien language glossary</ref> although not exclusively; the Twi'lek [[Mazie]] once insulted young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male, by calling him a "schutta."<ref name="Truth" /> It was also a favorite insult of some Humans, such as [[Atton Rand]] and [[Mirax Terrik Horn]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> It could also be spelled "'''shutta'''.<ref name="Glossary" />
